speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have been experiencing fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain for three weeks. To help me understand your condition better, can you tell me your age and how severe the pain in your legs is on a scale of 1 to 10?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). The combination of fatigue, bruising, fever, and severe bone pain in a 4-year-old is highly suggestive of leukemia; further workup with a Complete Blood Count and imaging is indicated.
